---
description: Push requirements (/requirements/) and Xray tests (/tests/) to Jira via MCP, create Relates and Test links, update issue_key in files, and rename files to <ISSUE_KEY>-<slug>.md.
---

Invoke the `openspec-push-jira` skill and follow its instructions to push Use Cases, Sub Use Cases, and Xray Tests to Jira and rename local `.md` files with their Jira `issue_key`.
